info.name: AI Platform Backend API
info.description: Postman collection derived strictly from the ai-platform-backend FastAPI source code (app/api/routes, app/schemas, app/dependencies). Base path has no global prefix; endpoints are mounted at root (e.g. /auth, /projects, /workflows, /runs, /providers, /health). Auth uses JWT Bearer tokens issued by /auth/login (OAuth2 password form) and /auth/register.

request.description:
Registers a new user. Auth: none. Body: RegisterRequest {email: EmailStr, password: str}. Password validated by validate_secure_password: min length 6, requires an uppercase letter, a digit, and a special character (see app/core PASSWORD_RULE_MESSAGE).
